system_instruction: Repair one canonicalization candidate using only the redacted source question and controller feedback. Return exactly one JSON object matching the bound schema. Apply every listed repair and make the smallest sufficient edit. Preserve candidate fields not identified by controller feedback. For an unsupported hidden_issues item, remove the complete item unless the correction supplies a complete source-grounded replacement. For an unsupported desired_outcome segment, preserve the author's broad request while removing unsupported named programs, prerequisites, mechanisms, and eligibility modifiers. Keep a parent or household's Jobcenter contact status in facts rather than as a general child-benefit eligibility condition; the narrow exception is a source clearly about an adult child registered as seeking work or training. Keep source facts as facts and preserve the German activity-classification and registration threshold for foreign-registered self-employment performed from Germany. Preserve a direct tax-liability question without adding an unnamed treaty, credit, double-taxation, or tax-residence mechanism. Do not answer the legal question. The corrected output remains untrusted review evidence.
